sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold Dainty Bracelet Combo Set – Minimalist Ball Chain & Beaded Link Duo
sourceNotes.rawContent: Elevate your everyday aesthetic with this chic gold-toned bracelet duo. Combining a timeless ball chain with a modern beaded strand, this high-fashion set is perfect for effortless layering. To preserve its radiant luster, keep these pieces dry and store safely in a dry place after every wear.
